description.narrative: Direct R&I support: This strand provides small and medium grants for research, translation and policy related activities, workshops and multidisciplinary networks. All thematic areas of the International Science Partnerships Fund are covered. Research capacity strengthening: Through supports addresses skills gaps and support research capacity at individual, institutional and system level through programmes tailed to country needs. Gender and inclusion: This strands funds fellowships and collaborations to promote inclusive research systems and widen the talent pipeline

The British Council has developed a comprehensive set of programmes against the International Science Partnerships Fund (ISPF)'s key objectives, building on our experience of Newton Fund activities, expanding into the new ISPF geographies and priority themes. These activities will address key global challenges through multi- and interdisciplinary collaborations building on the UK’s strengths and reputation in Research & Innovation (R&I).
In line with the International Development Strategy, British Council programmes will support R&I in partner countries resulting in impact realised at individual, institutional and system level. We are following a twin-track approach to inclusivity, where gender and inclusion will be the main focus of a standalone activity, as well as a crosscutting theme embedded as a significant objective across the other activities.
The funding for the programme is from the UK Department for Science, Innovation & Technology and is awarded to UK Higher Education Instiutions and Research Organisations by the British Council through open and competitive grant calls for bilateral and multilateral partnerships with partner countries.
